novelty_flags.label: project_justification / thm:atlas-completeness / thm:one-collision-classification
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal presents an extension beyond Ahn--Kasahara, but its all-primitive compact box is a strict instrumental narrowing of CS-LT and no statement proves a strict comparison on the published class or an independently motivated new-condition regime.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:hausdorff-consistency
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: BC(P) is accepted as an explicit additional branch-persistence premise rather than a conclusion of compactness alone.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Hausdorff and ordered-endpoint consistency are asserted only conditional on P in M_eta^bc; outside it, only the stated outer-excess conclusion is claimed.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a comparison theorem exhibiting a law in the published Ahn--Kasahara CS-LT model that fails ID, then prove exactly whether it belongs to M_eta and how the atlas gives a non-singleton or disconnected ATT region; otherwise stop calling the boxed result an extension and frame it as a new-condition result.

Resolve the all-primitive box issue by either extending the atlas to the CS-LT support class with boundary strata or supplying an independently empirical/scientific rationale and a boundary-sensitivity theorem showing what the box excludes.

Make AtlasATT genuinely constructive: state an explicit input encoding, output encoding, and bit/termination bound, and publish a fully worked one-collision and benchmark certificate rather than only the recursive elimination handle.

recommended_next_step: Revise the comparator framing and resolve or independently justify the instrumental compact-box restriction before advancing the field-tier atlas kernel.
